name: create_module
description: create_module attempts to create a loadable module entry and reserve the kernel memory needed to hold the module. This system call requires privilege and is deprecated, being present only in kernels before Linux 2.6.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the module to create

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the memory to reserve for the module

return_value.success: Returns the kernel address at which the module will reside
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, errno is set

errors.description: A module by that name already exists
name is outside the program’s accessible address space
The requested size is too small even for the module header information
The kernel could not allocate a contiguous block of memory large enough for the module
create_module is not supported in this version of the kernel (e.g., Linux 2.6 or later)
The caller was not privileged (did not have the CAP_SYS_MODULE capability)
